escape_hatch_families.MSL: missile-tuning triple-source merge: flat top-level entry + nested missile_tuning + nested guidance (with per-key aliases active_seek_range->seeker_lock_range, off_boresight_cap->max_launch_off_boresight_deg, and guidance.type->seeker_type)
escape_hatch_families.FUZ: fuze/fuse dual spelling (both -> parse_fuze_json_fields); nested trigger-radius alias chain trigger_radius_m | trigger_radius | radius_m (:476-482) and trigger_logic falling back to trigger_mode (:485-486)
